name: Baladna Q.P.S.C.
summary: Baladna Q.P.S.C., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells dairy products in Qatar. The company offers fresh, UHT, long life, hi-protein, and evaporated milk; labneh, dessert, yoghurt, and cheese; fresh and sterilized creams; Laban and Ayran milk drinks; chilled, UHT, and long-life juices; meat; and organic fertilizers. It is also involved in the slaughter of animals and sale of meat; trading of feed, food materials, plastic packaging, and dairy products; retail of dairy products, eggs, olives, and pickles in specialized stores; wholesale of soft drinks, juices, and mineral water; investment and management of agricultural projects; growing of cereals, leguminous crops, and oil …
